answer: Rhythm Commitment Window: each identity must emit a minimum number of signed actions per rolling epoch, spaced by a jitter tolerance so bursts don't count. An identity earns a thread score only when its inter-arrival timing stays inside a learned corridor; sybils faking many identities must each fund sustained, paced activity. Violators get their sonnet weight decayed and lose routing priority. An attacker pays per-identity compute and latency upkeep, and a willow-length warmup before any trust accrues.
